verdict.rationale: Dover's docs describe a careers page it generates for you by scanning your website, which suggests branding with no engineering work. Job changes appear on that careers page automatically, so jobs publish straight from the ATS. Nothing in the evidence shows hosting on the customer's own domain, though, and that is an explicit part of the story. missing for 10: custom-domain hosting, documented branding controls (logo/colors), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I get a hosted, branded careers page on my own domain — jobs publish to it straight from the ATS with no engineering work

citations.quote: Dover scans your website and uses the details about your company to create the page.
Changes appear on your posting, your careers page, and on any job boards connected to Dover.
Switch the preview between **Desktop** and **Phone** to check both.
